THE LITTLE DETAILS

Help & settings

512 × 512 PNG
How to play
◒

Match their recipe.Choose the base and add-ins shown on the order. Tap the ingredient containers to cycle their quantities.

①②

Mix two sodas.Follow the numbered bottles and fill lines. Hardcore gives one hold per soda; the last release serves.

◈

Ice adds a little drama.Tap the ice bin for one or two scoops. It adds fizz as you pour. Turn the machine’s pressure knob before the first hold to choose Gentle, Classic or Rush.

≋

Leave room for fizz.Foam settles into soda. The meter shows both; aim for the final liquid level.

★

Earn your stars.Match the recipe and fill. Good reviews grow streaks and future prices.

⌂

Grow your bar.Buy equipment, ingredients, seats, and staff. Receipts show what you earn and spend.

Controls & saving

Match the recipe, then hold Space or the main button to pour. In Easy, release to pause and hold again to top up; tap the smaller action or press Enter to switch soda or serve. The review appears after the foam settles. Enter or Next customer continues. P or Escape pauses. Leaving or pausing during a Hardcore pour ends that attempt.

Your finished cup stays beside its review; the receipt is in Details. Patience starts with your first recipe change; complex orders allow more time. Menus and settling pause it. Ingredients lock at the first pour. Changing difficulty starts a new streak.

Music and effects have separate controls. Your business saves on this device; export a backup from Build. Imported earlier saves keep their career progress.

A FRESH START

A brand-new business?

This resets your cash, reviews, upgrades, employees, and progress. Export a save first if you want to return to this business.
